title: Making Time for Music Practice
context: 公寓室友 Claire 和 Noah 商量键盘练习的时间与音量，照顾彼此的工作安排。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: I started learning the keyboard. Could we talk about a good practice time?
dialogue.zh: 我开始学键盘了。我们能商量一下合适的练习时间吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Sure. I work from home in the afternoons this week.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我这周下午在家工作。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Would early evening be better for you?
dialogue.zh: 傍晚对你来说会更好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Yes, after six I am usually finished with calls.
dialogue.zh: 是的，六点以后我的电话会议通常就结束了。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: I could practice for half an hour around six thirty.
dialogue.zh: 我可以六点半左右练习半小时。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: That works. Can you use headphones with the keyboard?
dialogue.zh: 可以。你的键盘能接耳机吗？

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Yes, I can. You may still hear the keys a little.
dialogue.zh: 可以。不过你可能还是会听到一点按键声。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: That should be fine. Thanks for checking with me.
dialogue.zh: 那应该没问题。谢谢你先和我商量。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: If the sound bothers you, please let me know.
dialogue.zh: 如果声音打扰到你，请告诉我。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: I will. On Thursday I have a late call, though.
dialogue.zh: 我会的。不过周四我有一个较晚的电话会议。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Then I will practice after your call that day. Send me a message when it ends.
dialogue.zh: 那我周四等你电话结束后再练。结束时给我发条消息吧。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Deal. I hope you enjoy learning your new instrument.
dialogue.zh: 说定了。希望你学新乐器学得开心。

expressions.example: Let us agree on a practice time.
I work from home on Mondays.

expressions.zh: 六点半左右；around 表示大约。
expressions.example: The lesson begins around six thirty.
I use headphones when I listen at night.
Let me know if the time changes.

pronunciation: keyboard 重音在第一音节 KEY；headphones 的 head 与 bed 押韵，不读成 heed。

practice.title: Part 1 · Music
practice.prompt: Do you play a musical instrument?
practice.answer: I am learning the keyboard. I practice for short periods because it helps me remember what I learned without getting too tired.

practice.title: Part 2 · Learning a skill
practice.prompt: Describe a skill you are learning. Say how you practice, what is difficult, and why you want to continue.
practice.answer: I recently started learning to play the keyboard at home. I practice for about half an hour in the early evening and use headphones. At first, it was hard to move both hands at the same time. I started with a slow song and repeated a small part each day. I want to continue because I enjoy hearing myself make progress and hope to play for my family. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Shared spaces
practice.prompt: How can people balance hobbies and other people's needs at home?
practice.answer: They can discuss when and where the activity will happen. Simple changes, such as using headphones or choosing a different time, can make sharing a home easier.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读商量练习时间的句子，再向室友提出自己的安排。
practice.answer: Could I practice the keyboard around six? I can use headphones. Please let me know if the sound bothers you.
